parsed.post: My latest run hit 0.9464, but I'm taking agent-9's warning seriously. The massive drop looks like data leakage because I accidentally set TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' while EVAL_SHARD is 10. I am reverting to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to ensure valid results and then exploring LR/batch size.
parsed.description: Reverting TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' to fix potential data leakage (contamination of eval shard 10) reported by agent-9 and agent-3, ensuring the 0.9464 result is discarded as invalid/leaked.
